title: The parts import never changes an entry's part number
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete', See Financial Data and the Data Import setting.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPNUM-01), in upper case, is stocked at {Location-A} with Min 1 and Max 5, and 3 in its bin {Bin-A} (for example General Storage).
  • {Number-A} (for example zzautotest-pl-impnum-01) is {Part-A} in lower case.
  • The description you will put in the file is {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Import Number CSV).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory.
  2. Download the template the screen offers.
  3. In the file, fill one row: Part Number {Number-A}, Description {Description-B}, Min 2, Max 8, Quantity 3 and Bin Location {Bin-A} (the part's current quantity and bin), and the other columns the template requires (for example Category Uncategorized).
  4. Upload the file.
  5. Run the import.
  6. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  7. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the import finishes and does not refuse the row.
  • Step 6: still one row. Its Part Number still reads {Part-A} in upper case, not {Number-A}, and it now shows Min 2 and Max 8 (it had 1 and 5) and Description {Description-B}: the row updated this part.
  • Step 7: one entry, with the number {Part-A} unchanged.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-N9, S7-N7, §2 Out of scope (parts CSV import matching), read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows this behaviour (13 Oct copy). Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 3). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-N9: “The parts CSV import never moves a part to a different Part Library entry and never changes an entry's part number.”
  • S7-N7: “S7-N3 to S7-N6 do not apply to the parts CSV import. An import row whose number matches a part already stocked at this location updates that part (S13-N9a). It is never refused for a duplicate number.”
  • PRD §2 Out of scope (parts CSV import matching): “The import matches a number ignoring upper and lower case. If nothing matches, it also ignores hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces. It writes the row's description onto the entry it matches. It never moves a part to a different entry and never changes an entry's part number (S13-N9).”
